name: Enpara Bank A.S.
summary: Enpara Bank A.S. provides banking services and products in Turkey. It operates through Retail, Corporate, and SME Banking segments. The company offers demand and time deposit accounts, loans, point of sale, cards, and transfers services, as well as gold accounts. It delivers its services through its online and mobile banking platforms. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in Istanbul, Turkey. Enpara Bank A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Digital-Q-FS Limited.
